diff --git a/cmake/Options.cmake b/cmake/Options.cmake
index b9a3c74..14a06e8 100644
--- a/cmake/Options.cmake
+++ b/cmake/Options.cmake
@@ -18,6 +18,13 @@ set(CCBENCH_ADD_ANALYSIS  0 CACHE STRING "extra per-tx analysis counters")
 # dir; never mix into a perf build (absolute discipline #1 / decisions.md D14).
 set(CCBENCH_TRACE         0 CACHE STRING "izanagi correctness trace (0=off, perf)")
 set(CCBENCH_BACK_OFF      1 CACHE STRING "exponential backoff on abort")
+# izanagi: static backoff magnitude (us) to bypass Cicada's adaptive hill-climb.
+# -1 (default) = stock adaptive Backoff_; >=0 = fixed value, ignores the leader's
+# gradient update. Used to sweep backoff magnitude as a single axis (P2 case study).
+set(CCBENCH_BACKOFF_FIXED -1 CACHE STRING "izanagi: static backoff us (-1=stock adaptive)")
+# izanagi (P2-4 profiler): 1 = backoff() を noinline 化し perf record で spin を独立シンボルに。
+# 有用 IPC (spin を除いた cycle/instruction) を分離する診断専用。0 (default) = inert (stock 不変)。
+set(CCBENCH_BACKOFF_NOINLINE 0 CACHE STRING "izanagi: noinline backoff() for perf attribution (0=inert)")
 set(CCBENCH_KEY_SIZE      8 CACHE STRING "key size in bytes (YCSB)")
 set(CCBENCH_MASSTREE_USE  1 CACHE STRING "use Masstree as the index")
 set(CCBENCH_VAL_SIZE      4 CACHE STRING "value size in bytes (YCSB)")
@@ -61,6 +68,8 @@ function(ccbench_universal_definitions out_var)
   set(${out_var}
     ADD_ANALYSIS=${CCBENCH_ADD_ANALYSIS}
     BACK_OFF=${CCBENCH_BACK_OFF}
+    BACKOFF_FIXED=${CCBENCH_BACKOFF_FIXED}
+    BACKOFF_NOINLINE=${CCBENCH_BACKOFF_NOINLINE}
     KEY_SIZE=${CCBENCH_KEY_SIZE}
     MASSTREE_USE=${CCBENCH_MASSTREE_USE}
     VAL_SIZE=${CCBENCH_VAL_SIZE}

+#ifndef BACKOFF_FIXED
+#error "BACKOFF_FIXED must be defined (-DBACKOFF_FIXED=-1 for stock adaptive; CMake supplies the default)"
+#endif

 using namespace std;

     Backoff_.store(new_backoff, std::memory_order_release);
   }

+  // 診断専用ノブ。既定 0 = stock (inline 候補のまま、挙動・命令列ともに完全不変 = inert)。

   static void backoff(size_t clocks_per_us) {

+    // EVOLVE-BLOCK-BEGIN silo-backoff-magnitude
+    // izanagi Phase 3 (D22/phase3.md): この条件コンパイル骨格 (if/else/endif の三枝) だけが

+    // 中身のみ — backoff の量 (now_backoff) を Cicada 適応 hill-climbing の代わりに合成する純
+    // timing 変異。stock 枝 (適応 Backoff_ を逐語温存) とマーカー・骨格は不可触 (人間が一度入れた)。

+#if BACKOFF_FIXED >= 0
+    double now_backoff = static_cast<double>(BACKOFF_FIXED);
+#else
     double now_backoff = Backoff_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
